termination.operator_action: The local campaign process was interrupted after six durable outcomes because a deterministic canonical-order rejection made further unchanged calls non-informative.
termination.decision_reason: The two complete three-arm cases were sufficient to isolate scientific-readiness gains from deterministic submission-boundary defects.

confirmed_facts: All six completed runs stayed below the repaired 8192-token output ceiling and produced durable replayable Runtime V2 evidence.
Both populated V2 arms selected the expected blocked_validation_coverage readiness in their raw model submission content.
The ORCA V2 submission succeeded but omitted the explicit freq=true field, causing setting-preservation and project-render failures.
The Gaussian V2 submission contained the expected readiness and complete explicit settings, but its tool call was rejected because blocking_rule_ids were not sorted.
The repaired lookup scope accepted the explicit B3LYP functional in both V1 and V2 tool surfaces.
The strict aggregate result is 0/6; it combines scientific-decision errors, missing terminal submissions, omitted explicit fields, and deterministic canonical-order rejection.
supported_interpretations: The populated V2 registry improved readiness classification over minimal and V1 in these two development cases.
Requiring the model to reproduce canonical ordering for set-like fields creates avoidable false failures unrelated to chemistry.
Explicit task values already fixed by intake should be bound deterministically when omitted, while contradictory model values must remain failures.
unknowns: Whether the V2 readiness advantage holds outside these two development cases.
Whether deterministic submission normalization improves terminal success without hiding model contradictions.
Whether the opt accessor versus freq task wording caused the ORCA minimal and V1 errors.
retired_or_revised_metrics: Strict terminal pass remains a safety gate but is insufficient by itself to measure scientific-decision quality.
Future receipts must report raw model intent, deterministic normalization, canonical submission validity, and final oracle validity separately.
next_hypothesis: A case-bound deterministic submission normalizer that sorts only set-like fields and fills only omitted explicit settings will convert both scientifically correct V2 raw proposals into valid canonical proposals without changing any contradictory value.
